items.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: So I remember getting to meet him and then getting to play with him, I was a little excited, like a little secret under my belt.

ctx.x: That was exciting too. Because when I was in those Buddy Rich influential days I remember reading something that Sweets was his favorite trumpet player. For whatever that’s worth. So I remember getting to meet him and then getting to play with him, I was a little excited, like a little secret under my belt. But yeah, some guys when you play with them boy they just hit one note and it’s like oh man you start— I know when something affects me positively I start laughing, I get giddy. So I mean I was giggling the…

The music scene has changed an awful lot, like since Sweets was a young man, you know. Does it seem healthy to you? I mean you seem to have found a number of niches but is it hopeful for guys in their teens right now that are coming up?
